title: Phonelink
missing: Backend missing. Install it using bin/install-user; guided installation is tracked in issue #5.
upgrade: Backend update required. Stop phonelink.service, install the current backend, then restart it.
stopped: Service stopped. Click to start the installed user service.
unavailable: Service unavailable. Check systemctl --user status phonelink.service.
runtime: Cannot coordinate tray mode. Check the graphical session runtime directory.
clickHint: Click to open Phonelink · Right-click to refresh
serviceError: Cannot start the user service. Check systemctl --user status phonelink.service and install the backend using bin/install-user.
setupHint: See the widget tooltip for service status. Install or update the backend using bin/install-user, then check systemctl --user status phonelink.service. Guided installation is tracked in issue #5.
